Star Fish Company.note: Only licensed candidate (Flickr 32449700360, Carol VanHook, CC BY-SA 2.0, Feb 2017) shows the STARFISH CO. building and dock, but about six diners sit mid-frame directly beneath the sign with two faces recognizable at full size. Crops were tested 2026-09-30: every crop that keeps the sign also keeps the diners, and the only diner-free crop is mostly sky and trees with the sign cut off at the bottom edge. Owner decision: no photo with recognizable diners, no generic substitute.
